dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the upper dorsal surface. One prominent 'O' ring in the anterior-dorsal region displays a jagged, high-contrast light perimeter with a sharp gradient transition to a dark core. A larger, irregular 'C' shape in the central dorsal region shows a thick, high-intensity boundary. A smaller, closed 'O' shape is visible in the posterior-dorsal region with a more diffuse light-to-dark gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated clusters of small, solid high-intensity light pixels are located along the lower lateral flank. These blobs lack internal gradients and appear as dense, asymmetrical groupings of 4-6 points in the mid-body region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the dorsal surface form an obtuse scalene triangle. The axis connecting the anterior-most 'O' and the central 'C' structure is approximately twice the length of the axis connecting the central 'C' to the posterior 'O' structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive reticulated pattern where light-colored, thin linear structures interconnect several smaller circular features across the mid-lateral surface, creating a web-like appearance.
